description: Owner-approved resolution of every route clash between a demonstration placeholder and a real (protected) resource in the private preview. A clash that is NOT listed here stops the build (fail closed): a real resource never replaces demo content by default, and grandfathering is not approval by itself. Stage 9.73 / 9.73A / 9.73B.
supersedesNote: EMPTY since Stage 9.73B. The Stage 9.38/9.39 supersession rule (a real resource silently replaces its demo placeholder and every reference follows it) is no longer used by any collision. The mechanism stays in the resolver so that a FUTURE collision can be given an explicit, written supersession approval here; nothing is superseded by default.

separateDemoNote: A separated placeholder is never aliased to the real resource, and it is hidden from listings (library, Start Here, foundations, categories, collections, downloads); it is not deleted or renamed, and stays reachable on its own demo- route and through explicit references (programme days, demo workshop, demo related links). The explicit private water-basics learning path (staged from private-assets, Stage 9.47) replaces the DEMO water-basics path file as a whole; that is an explicit private file, not an alias.
